annotations.title: Price a basket and get a checkout link

description: Prices a set of outlets and returns line items, any volume discount, the final total, and a checkout_url. The total matches what the buyer is charged, volume tiers included. It charges nothing and creates no order. checkout_url is the page where the buyer confirms the basket and pays; the card is charged at checkout and refunded if the placement is not published or the turnaround is missed.

id.description: Outlet id. List each outlet once: an order holds 1 placement per outlet.
